Find OPALX school and workshop material here, grouped by year. Each entry opens
an unnumbered page with preparation instructions, a course outline, and links
to the source material. Individual schools stay outside the numbered manual,
following the [Presentations and Reports](presentations-reports.qmd) catalog.

## Add an entry

Create a summary under `resources/schools/YYYY/` and add it to this catalog and
the [school archive](schools/index.html), newest first when event dates are
known. Keep individual school pages out of the book chapters in `_quarto.yml`.
Link course repositories through metadata. Original binary documents and large
course bundles belong in `opalx-documents`, as described in the
[Documentation Workflow](../developer-guide/documentation-workflow.qmd).

:::
